unique_context: PED's 'AI Guidance for K-12 Education 1.0' (signed April 29, 2025) is non-binding and self-described as in process; it builds on the 2023 Digital Equity in Education Act and uses a 'M.A.Z.E.' framework (Monitor, Assess, Zero-in, Evaluate). The Legislative Education Study Committee ran an AI working group in 2025 and in May 2026 its staff urged lawmakers to adopt comprehensive policy covering data privacy, curriculum and tribal sovereignty. HB 330 (2026) proposed AI ethics as a computer-science elective.
notes: AFT New Mexico expects AI language in teacher contracts by 2027. The LESC 2025 working-group report recommended a state oversight body.
